::: {#rem-hazard-range}
#### The range of a hazard

A hazard can exceed $1$:
@exm-hazard-exceeds-one has $\haz(t) = 2$.
Together with @thm-hazard-nonnegative,
the hazards of a [continuous](#def-continuous-rv) [random variable](#def-random-variable) take values in $[0, \infty)$.
The [discrete-time hazard](#def-discrete-hazard) differs:
it lies in $[0, 1]$ by @cor-discrete-hazard-unit-interval.

:::
